_doc: T2 dialect exclusions (M12 C07, #765): Octave test blocks whose expected behaviour differs from documented MATLAB behaviour. OpenMATLAB follows MATLAB; each block listed here is reported as category toolbox:octave-only, key dialect:<reason> and is outside the T2 rate (never a pass). Only block ids, sha256 hashes and our own reasons are stored: no Octave test source or expected values. An entry applies only while the block's hash matches.

reasons.interp1-extrap: MATLAB interp1 extrapolates by default for 'pchip', 'cubic' (= pchip), 'spline' and 'makima' (documented: https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/ref/interp1.html, extrapolation argument); Octave returns NA/NaN out of range.
reasons.median-class: MATLAB median returns natively in the class of A and has no outtype argument (documented: https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/ref/double.median.html); Octave's 'default' outtype returns double for integer and logical input.
reasons.var-dim-past-ndims: MATLAB var returns an array of zeros the same size as A when dim > ndims(A) (documented: https://www.mathworks.com/help/matlab/ref/double.var.html, dim argument); Octave returns NaN for non-finite elements.
